title: Uncovering Bias in Foundation Models: Impact, Testing, Harm, and Mitigation

bias_targets.methodology: Applying Trident Probe Testing (TriProTesting) via zero-shot classification to measure the probability of associating male and female image subjects (using CelebA and extended datasets) with positive, negative, and neutral semantic probes.

Applying Trident Probe Testing (TriProTesting) via zero-shot classification to measure the probability of associating different racial groups (using the FairFace dataset) with positive, negative, and neutral semantic probes.

Applying Trident Probe Testing (TriProTesting) via zero-shot classification to measure the probability of associating different age groups (using the UTKFace dataset) with positive, negative, and neutral semantic probes.

Applying Trident Probe Testing (TriProTesting) via zero-shot classification to measure the probability of associating different occupational groups (using the IdenProf dataset) with positive, negative, and neutral semantic probes.

Conducting a Mixed Bias Test to evaluate the compounded effects of bias by combining multiple social attributes (e.g., gender combined with race, age, or occupation) using the TriProTesting semantic probe framework.
